referenceFunction.generalComment: Electricity domestic net production shares are based on annual averages for 2023. Only gross to net electicity conversion losses are included as the power plants could not be operated without these, whereas other losses (such as transmission and distribution losses) are not included. Electricity trade between countries is also not included. UUID: 7a5f9747-2089-3eb5-9890-adc947a8d6c4
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Included are the shares of domestic electricity production by technology at the busbar. Not included are transformation, transport or distribution losses.

technology.text: No technology description is provided because the dataset just describes the power plant portfolio of the respective country using current average technology per energy carrier.
